So the line itself is clean — what you’re bracing for is the meaning she might attach to it. “Coffee near me” becomes “don’t come to my house,” and then “what’s wrong with the house.”

But notice: she’s never actually pushed past your first deflection. She asks once more, then lets it go. So there’s a gap between what you fear she’ll wonder and what she’s historically done with her wondering.

If she did wonder — and you just let her — what happens in you?
